description: Adds a HOW TO PLAY interactive in-world tutorial button on Dead City's existing main and pause menus. Starts a fresh playable training run with enemy waves held until tutorial is completed or skipped. Guides verified real movement, swipe aim, jump, double-tap-and-hold fire, weapon switching, reload, supply pickup, minimap/score/music and then starts normal survival waves. In-world compact guide with progress, back, next/skip-step and skip tutorial. Preserve existing gameplay, developer panel, Metal FM, portrait/landscape, world and HubSide portal. Node 22 manifest importer only.
